name: Ability check against a fixed DC (D&D 2024)
description: Rolls 1d20, adds the named ability's modifier derived from dnd2024.abilities, and compares the total to a DC the GM supplies. Returns the shared d20 envelope and no effects - a check answers whether it worked, it does not change the world. Source: SRD 5.2.1, Playing the Game: Ability Checks, CC-BY-4.0.
